verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
Praise Him you stars above
Galaxies all in motion
Praise Him you thunderclouds
Ringing throughout the Heavens

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
From every mountaintop
To every wild ocean
Oh, hear all the universe sing praise
Oh, sing praise

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Let everything that breathes
Let all the earth proclaim
Great is the Lord our God
Praise Him forever

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Let all that is within me
Magnify His name
Great is the Lord our God
Praise Him forever

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
Praise Him you beating hearts
Sing for the life He's given
Praise Him you rescued ones
Join in the sound of Heaven

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
From every mountaintop
To every wild ocean
Oh, hear all the universe sing praise
Oh, sing praise

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
Hear the holy roar
Hear this anthem rise
In the house of God
All creation cries

verse.name: e1
verse.lines:
Hear the holy roar
Hear the holy roar
Hear the holy roar
Praise Him forever
